Noah P: Quick sync: EdgeCloud wants Redwood to enable br-south-1 region (edge cluster) — asks: marketplace SKU entitlements, initial GPU reserve (8x A100-80), regional KMS/HSM pattern, and a short embargo for joint announce. Can partnerships + legal + ops advise?
Rafa (EdgeCloud): Hi! We can allocate 8 A100-80 (ec-a100-80) and allow bursts to ec-a10-40. We'll need Redwood to submit the entitlement form and confirm KMS integration (CloudHSM preferred). Target go-live: 2026-07-20.
Tanya R: Ops note 1: need exact SKU IDs, go-live commitment, and expected QPS/token throughput to request quotas. Also ask: fallback policy if reserved capacity saturated?
Rafa (EdgeCloud): SKU IDs: ec-a100-80-prod, ec-a10-40-burst. Fallback: automatic routing to a10 for non-SLA traffic, and partner agrees to add +5 GPUs within 5 business days if we hit >90% sustained.
Marcus O: Security/legal: CloudHSM OK, rotation cadence? Also need short addendum for in-region log residency.
Rafa (EdgeCloud): Rotation 90 days, no key export, envelope encryption accepted. Logs may remain in-region, minimal PII only.
Noah P: Draft entitlement payload below, I'll submit after we sign addendum:
```json
{
  "partner":"EdgeCloud",
  "region":"br-south-1",
  "skus":["ec-a100-80-prod","ec-a10-40-burst"],
  "reserved_capacity":8,
  "go_live_date":"2026-07-20"
}
```
LegalBot: addendum-template: br-residency-addendum-v1.docx uploaded to drive. Marcus please review.
PartnerOpsBot: submission_id=msub-20260615-991; status=review_pending; reviewer=marketplace@edgecloud.com
Tanya R: Ops runbook items: canary window 2026-07-13 10:00-13:00 UTC, success criteria: p95 < 250ms, sustained 400k tokens/hr, fallback <30%. I'll schedule.
Marcus O: Reviewing addendum now; will post comments by EOD Tue.
Rafa (EdgeCloud): We'll prepare partner-side canary and marketing blurb for review. Proposed public announce 2026-08-03 (two-week embargo).
Noah P: Thanks everyone. Actions: Marcus legal review, Tanya schedule canary, Noah to submit entitlement after addendum signed, Rafa to share partner blurb. Ping if blockers.
